event_summary: A yellow smiley-faced tennis ball remains on a black circular platform while its visible markings turn from front-facing to mostly hidden.
raw_event_description: At the start, a fuzzy yellow ball with a black smiley face is centered on top of a black round platform on a wooden table. Over time, the smiley face shifts toward the viewer's left side of the ball and then out of view, while the ball stays in approximately the same position on the platform. A pale curved tennis-ball seam becomes the main visible marking near the end. The camera view remains steady.

reasons: The ball, platform, tabletop, wall, and rear cable are visible at the start.
The ball is already positioned on the platform in the first frame.
The visible process continues through the clip.
